description: Stock price history as OHLCV bars for any ticker or company name: open, high, low, close, adjusted close and volume from 1-minute to monthly bars over 1 day to the full history, plus first, last, change, high and low. Use to chart a stock, backtest a signal, compute returns or feed indicators. Example: symbol=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

interval.description: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m, 1d, 1wk or 1mo (default suits the range; intraday bars reach back about 60 days)

symbol.description: Ticker (AAPL, ^GSPC, BTC-USD) or a company name

name: stock_history
title: Historical stock prices, OHLCV
